title: helichrysum eximium
intro: Helichrysum eximium, commonly known as the Golden Everlasting, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum eximium are attributed to its ability to inhibit histone deacetylases, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, particularly 1,8-cineole, and other volatile compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
